{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate descending to find the highest
conversion_rate_sorted = conversion_rate.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Display the conversion rates
conversion_rate_sorted"}
